svg.title: Periodic table of research interests
svg.desc: Sixteen interests laid out like the periodic table: neuroscience (connectomics, spiking networks, plasticity, neuromodulation, integrated information, insect vision), complex systems (neuroevolution, artificial life, multi-agent systems), language and AI (stylometry, LLM memory, game AI) and engineering (scientific computing, full-stack, mobile, developer tooling).

text.font-family: Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Text', Cambria, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ordered by curiosity, not by atomic number
